snippet:
import json, websockets.sync.client as wsc
with wsc.connect("ws://127.0.0.1:3900/ws/tts") as ws:
    ws.send(json.dumps({"text": TEXT, "voice": NELL_ID}))
    while isinstance(chunk := ws.recv(), bytes):
        play(chunk)  # 16-bit PCM, 24 kHz, as it is made

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:3900/v1", api_key="local")
with client.audio.speech.with_streaming_response.create(
        model="omnivoice", voice="NELL_ID", input=TEXT) as r:
    r.stream_to_file("take.mp3")
